svg.title: Local model quality and peak VRAM by workload

cc:Work.dc:title: Local model quality and peak VRAM by workload
cc:Work.dc:description: Two panels plot each deployment by GPU memory and correctness for everyday jobs or email extraction. Labels mark the best deployment in each displayed memory budget.
